_comment: The store listing, as data. `store/check-listing.mjs` reads this; `store/LISTING.md` explains
why it cannot be uploaded. The Chrome Web Store API has no method for any field below, so this
file is not a deployment target — it is the repository's copy of what the Developer Dashboard
is supposed to say, kept here so that drift is detectable instead of merely likely.
The two long fields live beside this file as plain text, because they are pasted verbatim into
the console and a JSON string full of escaped newlines is not pasteable.
name: Parle
_permissionsComment: The permission set the shipped package must declare, asserted by store/check-release.mjs.
It lives here rather than in that script because it is the same list the Privacy tab writes a
justification for (listing.md §2.2): an undeclared extra permission blocks submission, and a
permission removed from the build but left justified is a listing that describes a different
extension. Changing what the extension asks for is therefore one edit, not two, and the
package audit fails until it is made.
